note: hCaptcha is a hook_captcha() integration for the contrib CAPTCHA module. It has no plugins, no Drush, one permission (administer hcaptcha) and one config object (hcaptcha.settings: site_key, secret_key, hcaptcha_src, widget.theme/size/tabindex/max_score). A form is protected by assigning the challenge hcaptcha/hCaptcha either as a captcha.captcha_point.<form_id> config entity or as captcha.settings.default_challenge. Because real hCaptcha verification needs external keys and a live browser challenge, all medium/hard cases are grounded in local config only: introspection reads back known hcaptcha.settings widget values and a captcha point's captchaType; execution sets the config keys/theme and creates a captcha point that assigns the hCaptcha challenge, both verified against live config. Namespaced test artifacts: captcha points hcaptcha_eval_contact (medium) and hcaptcha_eval_form (hard).

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site using the hcaptcha module, where are the hCaptcha site key and secret key stored (which config object and keys), and which admin route/permission gates the settings form?
evals.expected_output: Keys live in the hcaptcha.settings config object as site_key and secret_key (plus hcaptcha_src and widget.theme/size/tabindex/max_score). The settings form is route hcaptcha.admin_settings_form at /admin/config/people/captcha/hcaptcha, gated by the 'administer hcaptcha' permission.

evals.prompt: I enabled the Drupal hcaptcha module but have not entered a site key or secret key yet. What challenge do users actually see on a protected form, and why?
evals.expected_output: When either site_key or secret_key is empty, hook_captcha generate() returns captcha_captcha('generate', 'Math'), so the form falls back to the CAPTCHA module's built-in Math challenge instead of rendering the hCaptcha widget. This keeps the form protected until keys are provisioned.

evals.prompt: The hcaptcha module has no 'protect this form' setting of its own. How do you actually make a specific Drupal form show the hCaptcha widget, and what is the challenge identifier?
evals.expected_output: hCaptcha registers the challenge 'hCaptcha' (identifier hcaptcha/hCaptcha) via hook_captcha. You assign it through the CAPTCHA module: either create a captcha.captcha_point.<form_id> config entity with captchaType 'hcaptcha/hCaptcha', or set captcha.settings.default_challenge to 'hcaptcha/hCaptcha' for all forms.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the hCaptcha widget has been customised in hcaptcha.settings. Inspect the live configuration and report the configured widget theme and the maximum score value.
evals.expected_output: hcaptcha.settings has widget.theme = 'dark' and widget.max_score = 0.3 (read via 'drush cget hcaptcha.settings').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site a CAPTCHA point protects the form with id 'hcaptcha_eval_contact'. Inspect the live CAPTCHA configuration and state which challenge type (captchaType) is assigned to that form.
evals.expected_output: The config entity captcha.captcha_point.hcaptcha_eval_contact has captchaType 'hcaptcha/hCaptcha' — i.e. the form is protected by the hCaptcha challenge.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the hcaptcha module so the hCaptcha widget is ready to render: set a non-empty site key and secret key in hcaptcha.settings, and set the widget theme to 'dark'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: hcaptcha.settings now has a non-empty site_key and secret_key and widget.theme === 'dark' (e.g. via 'drush cset hcaptcha.settings site_key ...', secret_key, and widget.theme dark).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, protect the form with id 'hcaptcha_eval_form' with the hCaptcha challenge using the CAPTCHA module. Create the CAPTCHA point on the live site so that form's captchaType is the hCaptcha challenge provided by the hcaptcha module.
evals.expected_output: A captcha_point config entity with id/formId 'hcaptcha_eval_form' exists (config captcha.captcha_point.hcaptcha_eval_form) with captchaType 'hcaptcha/hCaptcha'.
